annotations.title: Put the brand kit on clips

description:
Use this when the user wants their brand on finished clips: "put my logo on these clips", "brand all of
these". Sets the logo, the first two colors as caption and highlight colors and the first font as caption font;
intro, outro and music are added in the editor. Each clip is re-rendered as an undoable version (undo_edit); a
Premium option is refused on the free plan by name.
Not for: changing the kit (set_brand_kit) or other looks (style_clip). Costs no Horizon Units. Returns a job_id
per clip; job_status waits for it.

clip_ids.description: Clip ids from list_clips, up to 10 videos per call (each is re-rendered).

logo_id.description: Logo id from get_brand_kit. Empty uses the first logo.

parts.description: Which parts of the kit to apply: any of logo, colours, font. Empty or left out applies everything the kit holds.
